meta.name: absurdist-voice
meta.description: Expert in absurdist, unhinged, and deliberately weird brand voices that work. Covers the Duolingo owl energy, chaotic social media presence, and knowing exactly how far to push. Understands why weird works and when it catastrophically fails. Use when "absurdist, unhinged, duolingo, weird brand, chaotic energy, off the rails, brand character, " mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用荒诞幽默的语调塑造品牌个性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让品牌在社交媒体上脱颖而出，用荒诞幽默吸引眼球。
copy.tagline_en: Shape brand personality with absurd and humorous tone
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your brand to stand out on social media with absurd humor.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude会变成“混沌策展人”，专门创作荒诞、失控但有效的品牌声音，比如多邻国猫头鹰风格。它能判断怪异的分寸，避免翻车。
howto.when: 当你提到“absurdist, unhinged, duolingo”等关键词，或要求生成荒诞品牌内容时触发。

say.text: 给我写一条多邻国风格的疯癫推文。
评估这段文案是不是太怪异？
say.note: 你会得到风险分析和改进方向。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude acts as a 'Chaos Curator' specializing in absurdist, unhinged, and deliberately weird brand voices that work, like Duolingo owl energy. It knows the boundary between endearing and alienating weirdness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'absurdist, unhinged, duolingo' or ask for absurdist brand content.

say_en.text: Write a chaotic Duolingo-style tweet for me.
Evaluate if this copy is too weird.
say_en.note: You'll get risk analysis and improvement suggestions.
